description: This is a Java source file implementing an Android Activity named 'ImagePixelization'. The activity demonstrates image pixelization effects, including custom pixelization, built-in bitmap scaling, and asynchronous processing to keep the UI responsive. It manages user interactions such as a seekbar for pixelization level, animations, and options menu items.

classes.name: ImagePixelization
classes.description: Main activity class that handles pixelization effects, user interaction, and background processing.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, loads image resource, and assigns event listeners.

methods.name: checkIfShouldPixelize
methods.description: Checks if enough time has passed to trigger a new pixelization process.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML layout.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, including starting animations and toggling options.

methods.name: customImagePixelization
methods.description: Performs manual pixelization by averaging pixels within regions.

methods.name: builtInPixelization
methods.description: Performs pixelization using bitmap scaling operations for better performance.

methods.name: invokePixelization
methods.description: Triggers pixelization either synchronously or asynchronously based on user settings.

methods.name: pixelizeImage
methods.description: Chooses which pixelization method to apply based on user options.

methods.name: PixelizeImageAsyncTask
methods.description: An AsyncTask subclass that runs pixelization in the background and updates the UI upon completion.
